# Rocklizard Adventure

> Rocklizard Adventure organizes guided treks and expeditions in Uttarakhand (Kumaon and Garhwal), Kashmir, and Maharashtra, as well as road and bike trips across India.

## Plan a trip

- [Treks](https://therocklizard.com/treks): Browse guided treks and open individual itineraries for route, difficulty, and trip details.
- [Expeditions](https://therocklizard.com/expeditions): Browse expeditions and find detailed itineraries.
- [Road and bike trips](https://therocklizard.com/trips): Compare routes, distances, vehicle arrangements, and departure details.
- [Contact](https://therocklizard.com/contact): Ask about a trip, check availability, or enquire about a custom itinerary.

## About Rocklizard

- [About](https://therocklizard.com/about): Learn about Rocklizard Adventure and its team.
- [Collaborations](https://therocklizard.com/collaborations): Find information for travel partners and collaborators.
